question: Will AfD win the most seats in the 2026 Berlin state elections?
resolution_criteria:
Parliamentary elections to elect the Abgeordnetehaus of Berlin are scheduled to take place in Berlin on September 20, 2026.

This market will resolve to the political party that wins the greatest number of seats in the formal deliberative assembly of Berlin (Abgeordnetenhaus) as a result of this election.

If voting in the Berlin election for the Abgeordnetenhaus does not occur by December 31, 2026, this market will resolve to "Other".

In the case of a tie between this party or coalition and any other for the most seats won, this market will resolve in favor of the party or coalition whose listed abbreviation comes first in alphabetical order.

This market's resolution will be based solely on the number of seats won by the named party or coalition.

This market will resolve based on the election results, as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Election Office of Berlin (Landeswahlleiter Berlin https://www.berlin.de/wahlen/)

# AfD and the most seats in the 2026 Berlin election: research notes (as of 2026-09-16)

Page fetches kept failing (the proxy refused the connection), so most facts below come from search-result summaries of the cited pages. They have not been checked directly. Some results also contained material dated after 2026-09-16. I left all of it out.

## 1. Resolution source
- I could not reach berlin.de/wahlen. The election is scheduled for 2026-09-20, so as of 2026-09-16 no results can exist on the Landeswahlleiter site.
- The 2023 repeat election is the most recent official baseline. CDU came first with about 28.2% and won the most seats. AfD got about 9.1% and 17 seats. [statista](https://de.statista.com/statistik/daten/studie/3114/umfrage/endergebnis-der-wahl-zum-abgeordnetenhaus-in-berlin)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. Voting is still four days away. AfD has never been the largest party in the Abgeordnetenhaus. In none of the September polls I found was AfD in first place.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-13: Prediction Hunt ran an article saying "Linke leads Berlin polls but internal paper…". I could only see the headline. [predictionhunt](https://www.predictionhunt.com/news/linke-leads-berlin-polls-but-internal-paper-sep-13-2026)
- 2026-09-11: Forschungsgruppe Wahlen for ZDF (Politbarometer Extra): Linke 23, CDU 21, AfD 17, Grüne 16, SPD 10. ZDF called it a two-way race between Linke and CDU. The fieldwork came after the Saxony-Anhalt election. [ZDF](https://www.zdfheute.de/politik/deutschland/berlin-wahl-abgeordnetenhaus-politbarometer-extra-100.html)
- About 2026-09-10: Infratest dimap for ARD: Linke 21, CDU 20, AfD 18, Grüne 16, SPD 12, BSW 4. Infratest described it as neck and neck. [Infratest dimap](https://www.infratest-dimap.de/umfragen-analysen/bundeslaender/berlin/laendertrend/2026/september-ii/)
- 2026-09-07: After the AfD landslide in Saxony-Anhalt (it narrowly missed an absolute majority), its market odds of winning Berlin reportedly doubled from about 8% to 18%. Polls still had AfD third or fourth in Berlin. [predictionhunt](https://www.predictionhunt.com/news/afd-berlin-win-odds-double-to-18-after-saxony-sep-07-2026)
- 2026-09-04: INSA for BILD: CDU 20, Linke 19, AfD 18, Grüne 15, SPD 15, BSW 3. AfD was up 1 point from 14 August. [DAWUM](https://dawum.de/Berlin/INSA/2026-09-04/)
- Undated, around early September: one INSA poll had AfD in second place for the first time, behind CDU. [Berliner Kurier](https://www.berliner-kurier.de/article/berlin-wahl-steht-bevor-afd-ist-laut-umfrage-jetzt-die-zweitstaerkste-kraft-10021047)
- 2026-08-27 to 08-31: Infratest dimap for RBB: CDU 21, Linke 19, AfD third (number not given in the summary). [dawum Infratest](https://dawum.de/Berlin/Infratest_dimap/)
- 2026-08-04 to 08-18: Forsa: Linke 22, CDU 18, AfD 18, Grüne 16, SPD 12. [t-online](https://www.t-online.de/nachrichten/deutschland/innenpolitik/id_101374354/berlin-wahl-2026-wahlumfragen-zeichnen-knappes-rennen-ums-abgeordnetenhaus.html)
- About 2026-07-21: INSA had AfD first at 19, with CDU and Linke both at 18. This is the only poll I found with AfD in the lead. [infranken](https://www.infranken.de/deutschland/insa-umfrage-afd-in-berlin-auf-platz-eins-art-6382690,PRINT), [politpro](https://politpro.eu/en/berlin/opinion-polls/insa-2026-07-21/state-election)

## 4. Base rates
- Berlin elections before 2026 (2016, 2021, 2023): AfD's best result was about 14% in 2016. It has never come first.
- In 2026 polling, AfD has mostly sat at 16-19%, usually third, 1-6 points behind the leader. Only one poll (INSA, July) had it first. In the September polls I found, AfD trailed the leader by 2-6 points.
- In the 2026 cycle, the gap between the top three parties has been within the typical error of a state poll (about ±3 points). Berlin polls have historically missed by 2-4 points for individual parties.
- The seat count tracks vote share closely: seats are allocated proportionally with a 5% threshold, and overhang seats are compensated. So whichever party has the most votes should also have the most seats.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-05-18: Polymarket (via Orrery) had CDU at 34%, Grüne 28%, Linke 20%, SPD 6%. [orrery](https://www.orrery.me/markets/will-cdu-win-the-most-seats-in-the-2026-berlin-state-elections)
- 2026-08-21: Linke was at about 39% to win the most seats, with CDU close behind. [predictionhunt](https://www.predictionhunt.com/news/berlin-election-polls-linke-odds-39-aug-21-2026)
- 2026-09-07: AfD was at about 18%. [predictionhunt](https://www.predictionhunt.com/news/afd-berlin-win-odds-double-to-18-after-saxony-sep-07-2026)
- About 2026-09-11: Linke was at about 58%, then about 68-69% on Kalshi and Polymarket after the mid-September polls. AfD was reported at roughly 16-18%. These come from a secondary aggregator. [predictionhunt](https://www.predictionhunt.com/news/linke-hits-58-in-berlin-election-market-sep-11-2026)
- I also saw an undated quote of 11¢ for AfD's most-seats contract, which may be stale. [simplefunctions](https://simplefunctions.dev/markets/berlin-state-election-winner-afd-polymarket-0x8aaaca6ea5)
- I could not find any Manifold market or independent expert seat model.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- More polls may appear before the vote, possibly from INSA, Forsa, Civey or YouGov. German pollsters usually stop publishing in the last days before an election.
- Election day is 2026-09-20. ARD and ZDF will publish exit polls and projections at 18:00 CEST, and the Landeswahlleiter will post a preliminary result that night.
- Factors that could still move things: late shifts after the Saxony-Anhalt result, turnout, and BSW or FDP falling under or getting over the 5% threshold, which changes how seats are split.
